reference.source: Long Cases in Clinical Medicine (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
reference.pathophysiology: Pulseless VF and VT take unsynchronised shocks with adrenaline and amiodarone timing while Hs and Ts reverse concurrently under capnography-guided compressions; ROSC cools toward TTM and PCI, DNAR frames limits, and minimal pauses with debriefs close the loop.
additionalDifferentials: Seizure versus syncope versus stroke versus overdose by breathing pulses imaging and pupils
VF versus PEA versus asystole by rhythm pulse and ultrasound
Cardiac versus respiratory versus metabolic by prodrome gases and Hs-Ts
